name: Via Ferrata Fürenwand (Engelberg)
summary: Exposed, ultra-vertical alpine face climbing with a dramatic wire ladder exit. Spectacular views of Mount Titlis.

name: Via Ferrata Diavolo (Andermatt)
summary: Historic, scenic route traveling straight through Schöllenen Gorge over the iconic Devil's Bridge monuments.

name: Via Ferrata Jägihorn (Saas-Fee)
summary: The highest via ferrata in the Western Alps, reaching 3,206m. Features an optional 4-cable suspension bridge.
